title: RMTI Sandbox — Disaster Science: Reference Implementation of the Risk Mechanism Theory Index
description:
Interactive, self-contained reference implementation (a single HTML file) of the Risk Mechanism Theory Index (RMTI) for urban, infrastructure and disaster-risk assessment. It implements the RMTI equations R = L·E·V·(1−ρ) and EAL = L·C·(1−ρ), the fixed five-tier scale, and a log-normalized exposure helper, with six worked city examples and a Custom / Your Field mode in which users name and score their own field.

Intended use and limitations. Educational and research use only. Scores are relative, rubric-based indices, not forecasts, engineering assessments or actuarial figures, and the worked examples are teaching illustrations rather than official assessments. The tool is not a substitute for professionally validated hazard and risk assessments.

An independent academic tool; not an official product of the World Bank Group or any other institution. A separate sandbox covers oncology and public-health surveillance.
